core.label: Core contracts
core.description: Shared application contracts and framework-independent exceptions.

web.label: REST API
web.description: Spring MVC response contracts and exception mapping.

jpa.label: Data JPA
jpa.description: JPA base entities and auditing backed by PostgreSQL.
jpa.setup: Export the datasource variables from `.env.example` and apply your application-owned migrations. Configure Flyway if you use it.

security.label: Servlet security
security.description: Servlet security with API error responses.
security.setup: Supply your authentication mechanism and set the application's route authorization rules.

auth.label: Local identities
auth.description: Persist local users and connect external identities.
auth.setup: Apply the local identity migrations and configure account provisioning before enabling `base.auth.local.enabled`.

token.label: Access and refresh tokens
token.description: Issue and validate first-party access tokens and rotate refresh tokens.
token.setup: Configure a signing key and issuer, apply the token migrations, and scope token issuance to trusted application authentication before enabling `base.auth.token.enabled`.

oidc.label: OIDC login
oidc.description: Optional Google or Apple sign-in for local identities.
oidc.setup: Set the provider client credentials, redirect URI, and account linking policy before enabling `base.auth.oauth2.enabled`.

email.label: Email authentication
email.description: Persist verified email identities and opt in to password authentication.
email.setup: Apply the email authentication migrations and supply an email sender for flows that deliver a message before enabling email authentication.

smtp.label: SMTP delivery
smtp.description: Provider-independent email with an SMTP transport.
smtp.setup: Configure the SMTP host and sender address before enabling `base.mail.smtp.enabled`. Supply SMTP credentials through your deployment environment if required.

phone.label: Phone authentication
phone.description: Persist verified phone identities and opt in to SMS challenges.
phone.setup: Apply the phone authentication migrations and supply an SMS sender before enabling OTP.

websocket.label: STOMP WebSocket
websocket.setup: Configure trusted origins and message authorization before enabling `base.websocket.enabled`.

mcp.label: MCP server
mcp.description: Optional Spring AI MCP HTTP endpoint with bearer-token validation.
mcp.setup: Configure the issuer and resource URI and keep a protected fallback security chain before enabling `base.mcp.server.enabled`.

sms.label: SMS contracts
sms.description: Outbound SMS interfaces and message contracts.
